Bug-fix alpha.

## Fixed
- **Parent accounts:** "My timetable" shows your child's timetable instead of failing with "request.type is null". With several children, switch between them in the drawer. **Parents who added their account before this version need to remove it and log in again**, so the app can learn about the children.
- **Office hours:** they are now actually requested. Before, nothing was sent when the account had no class assigned (all parents and some students).
- **Export:** PDF and XLSX follow your text settings: font size, bold subject and centred text. There's a new "Use text settings" switch in the export sheet.

## Improved
- Debug screen: new ⋮ menu to fetch user data and office hours on demand, for bug reports. App secrets and tokens are no longer stored in the debug log.

## Install
**Android:** download the `.apk` and open it. It updates the previous alpha in place.

**iPhone / iPad:** sideload the unsigned `.ipa` with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io).

**Web:** unpack `…-web-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `./bbu_server`, or use the Dockerfile from the repo (see `WEB.md`).
